description: This file defines the SerializedObjectDAO interface for managing serialized OpenmrsObjects in the database, including methods for retrieving, saving, deleting, and handling serialization specifics.

methods.name: getSerializedObject
methods.description: Retrieves the raw SerializedObject from the database by id.

methods.name: getObject
methods.description: Retrieves the saved object of a specified type and id from the database.

methods.name: getSerializedObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves the serialized object from the database by uuid.

methods.name: getObjectByUuid
methods.description: Retrieves the saved object of a specified type and uuid from the database.

methods.name: saveObject
methods.description: Saves an OpenmrsObject to the database in serialized form.

methods.name: saveObject with serializer
methods.description: Saves an OpenmrsObject to the database using a specified serializer.

methods.name: getAllSerializedObjects
methods.description: Retrieves all serialized objects matching a type, including or excluding retired objects.

methods.name: getAllObjects
methods.description: Retrieves all non-retired objects of a specified type.

methods.name: getAllObjects with includeRetired
methods.description: Retrieves all objects of a specified type, with optional inclusion of retired objects.

methods.name: getAllSerializedObjectsByName
methods.description: Retrieves serialized objects matching a type and name, with exact or partial match.

methods.name: getAllObjectsByName
methods.description: Retrieves objects matching a type and name, with exact or partial match.

methods.name: convertSerializedObject
methods.description: Converts a SerializedObject into an OpenmrsObject of a specified class.

methods.name: purgeObject
methods.description: Deletes an object from the database by id.

methods.name: getRegisteredTypeForObject
methods.description: Returns the registered class type for a given OpenmrsObject.

methods.name: getSupportedTypes
methods.description: Returns all supported object types managed by this DAO.

methods.name: registerSupportedType
methods.description: Registers a class as supported for serialization/deserialization.

methods.name: unregisterSupportedType
methods.description: Unregisters a class from the supported types.
